name: Custodia (monstrance), Castilla, first third of the 17th century (base) and 18th century (astil and sun)
note: Gilded sunburst monstrance with a knopped stem and a round glass lunette, topped by a cross. Per the printed caption, the foot dates to the early 17th century and the stem and radiant sun to the 18th century. The maker is unknown and I did not find a source online.
credit: Caption: "3. Custodia, Castilla, primer tercio del siglo XVII (pie) y siglo XVIII (astil y sol)." Collection and publication not identified.
